description: Read a dependency class's Java source, ideally only specific methods via methodNames (or startLine/endLine). Use only when you need the implementation, not names or signatures. Sources JAR if present, else decompiled (sourceAvailable=false). Whole files over ~64KiB are refused: pass methodNames.

className.description: FQN, e.g. com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; a unique simple name works.

methodNames.description: Only these methods ("<init>" = constructors), all overloads. Omit for the whole class.

modulePath.description: Gradle path like ':app', or a file/dir inside the module. Omit (or "*") for all modules.

projectRoot.description: Project root. Omit to use the workspace.

name: get_class_source
title: Get Java source for a class
